value.name: OntoNotes 5.0 PropBank roleset distribution
value.description: Per-verb counts of PropBank rolesets in the English portion of OntoNotes 5.0 (Weischedel et al. 2013), one entry per (verb, roleset) row of data/propbank-sense-distribution.csv, with the raw count and the log marginal and verb-conditional probabilities as features. These counts weight the multi-membership sense term (§2.4) and the same-sense predictor (§5.4). Where the roleset still exists in the PropBank 3.4 frames, ontologyTypeRef points at its typeDef in the Layers PropBank ontology; OntoNotes rolesets retired before PropBank 3.4 carry only a knowledgeRef with the OntoNotes roleset id.
